units.rawText: What each individual is responsible for in the Oasis is matched to their capabilities and preferences, yes? How laid-back.

units.rawText: When a human gives a Doll an order, it is to be completed, and whether or not the Doll is capable of it is not factored in. "At all cost" is the mantra that a Doll must follow.

units.rawText: Of course, there'll be those like you who think for the Dolls instead. No, I don't mean to challenge that position of yours. That said, if you want to champion your own ideals, then you must have the strength to defend it.
